## What's new

- One visual language across the whole app. Buttons, inputs, tabs, segmented controls, cards, badges, status dots, empty states and modals now share one family of sizes, radii, shadows and colours, so the same control looks the same on every page.
- Readable text again: every sub-11px size is gone — the 8–10.5px range that is effectively unreadable in Chinese — and the type scale collapses from 24 sizes to 9 steps with an 11px hard floor.
- Page action groups sit on one row with the primary action first, instead of the main button wrapping onto a second line under the secondary ones.
- The status column speaks one language: the old mix of badges, "▶ status" text and bare grey text is unified into a single chip family, and row action buttons share one icon-button spec.
- The settings sub-navigation has a real active state — the current section is highlighted and the indicator follows the section you jump to.
- Loading is one system now: spinner and skeleton placeholders replace ad-hoc waiting text, and the sidebar loading badge no longer breaks across lines.
- Off-palette colour is gone: the stray purple accent family (26 uses) and the cool-grey neutral family (42 uses) resolve to the brand green and the warm neutrals; radii collapse from 16 values to a 6-step scale, odd spacing outliers from 347 to 10 (the remaining 10 are deliberate 1px hairline gaps), and shadow literals from 16 to one 4-step set. Hard-coded colours drop from 341 to 31 (17 token definitions, 13 test-locked literals).

## Notes

- This is a visual-only release. No behaviour, interaction flow, wording or data format changed: everything you could do in v3.0.1 works exactly as before.
- Functional invariants were deliberately left byte-identical — paged block sizes, the three column widths (228 / 286 px), the responsive breakpoint and the shared `--control-height` are behaviour, not styling. The 22 literal CSS rules, 179 DOM locks and 256 copy locks in the test suite are untouched (zero test edits).
- Automated gates pass on the frozen source: `deno task check` and `deno task test` (773 passed / 0 failed).
- Repository state only, not a user-facing change: the `workbench-3.0.0` branch has been merged into `main` and deleted; local and remote keep `main` alone.
- Some cosmetic gaps are left on purpose: icons are still text glyphs (no icon library yet), the app remains light-theme only, and the deliberate 1px hairline gaps stay as they are.
